en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside street in a European town. On the left stand ornate multi‑storey buildings and industrial facilities with a tall factory chimney. A river runs through the center with a metal footbridge crossing it. On the right is a tree‑lined road with railings along the riverbank and houses in the background, with low forested hills beyond. Printed caption text appears in the upper right corner.
